title: Seal Beach Tennis & Pickleball Center

services.name: Facility Rental
services.desc: Host your next private corporate event in a dynamic and engaging environment, where team-building meets fun on our state-of-the-art courts. With customizable packages and professional private lessons available, your team will enjoy a unique experience that fosters collaboration and camaraderie! Transform your school events into memorable experiences with our spacious facility and expert tennis and pickleball pros, perfect for sports days, tournaments, or team-building activities. Our engaging programs promote teamwork and physical fitness, ensuring students have a blast while developing their skills on the court! Our center is an ideal venue for private events like birthdays and weddings.

services.name: Pickleball Programs
services.desc: The SBPA was formed with the authorization of the City of Seal Beach and in cooperation with the Seal Beach Recreation and Community Services Department to promote pickleball at the Seal Beach Tennis & Pickleball Center. The SBPA was incorporated as a Non-Profit 501(c)(3) in November 2021 by a group of active members

explain.meaning: A paddle game like tennis on a small court, easy for beginners.

blurb: The Seal Beach Tennis and Pickleball Center, where sports enthusiasts of all levels come together to enjoy top-notch facilities and a vibrant community atmosphere. Our center boasts 20 pickleball courts and 11 tennis courts, providing ample space for players to hone their skills and compete in friendly matches.
